transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been struggling with eating massive amounts of food in a really short time. Once I start, I feel like I completely lose control and just can't stop myself. It's been happening a lot and I'm really starting to worry about it.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever do anything to try to prevent weight gain, such as making yourself throw up, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?

Yes, I feel so ashamed and panicked afterward that I usually force myself to throw up or take laxatives. I'll also fast for days or exercise for hours to try and make up for it because I'm just so terrified of gaining weight.
To help me understand your physical health, could you tell me your current height and weight, or if you have recently lost a significant amount of weight?
I honestly avoid looking at the scale because seeing the number makes me so anxious. Because of that, I'm not really sure of my exact weight, and I don't know if I've actually lost any recently.
Have your family, friends, or doctors expressed concern recently that you have become dangerously thin or underweight?
No, no one has ever expressed concern about that. My family and friends haven't said anything about me being dangerously thin or underweight.
Even without knowing the exact number on the scale, do you feel like your current body weight is generally considered normal for your height, or do you think you look very thin?

I'm really not sure if my weight is normal or if I look thin to others. All I know is that I am constantly terrified of gaining even a single pound, and the thought of the scale just makes me incredibly anxious.
Have you noticed any physical changes recently, such as feeling cold all the time, feeling dizzy when standing up, or your clothes becoming much looser?
I haven't really noticed feeling cold or dizzy at all. And to be honest, I'm not really sure if my clothes have been getting looser either.
How often do these episodes of binge eating and purging or fasting happen, and for how many months has this been going on?
Both the overeating and the throwing up or fasting happen at least once a week on average. This entire cycle has been going on for about a year and five months now.
How much does your body shape or weight influence how you feel about yourself as a person overall?

Honestly, my weight and shape completely determine how I feel about myself, and my entire self-worth depends on them. I obsessively check the scale, and even the slightest increase makes me feel incredibly anxious, miserable, and filled with self-loathing.

latest_inference.note: The patient meets all DSM-5 criteria for Bulimia Nervosa: recurrent episodes of binge eating, recurrent inappropriate compensatory behaviors (vomiting, laxatives, fasting, excessive exercise) occurring at least once a week for over a year, and self-evaluation unduly influenced by body shape and weight. Anorexia Nervosa is unlikely as there is no indication of significantly low body weight or associated physical symptoms. Therefore, the candidate list remains Bulimia Nervosa and we can finalize the diagnosis.
